The AI companies want to gobble up all the electricity in America and make you pay for it while they replace every worker they can with an algorithm. These people have lost their moral compass. It’s time to remind them what’s right and what’s wrong @teamsters

Video

It is right to pay a working man what he deserves and to fight for an economy of right and wrong

If the @Teamsters are strong for another 123 years, I’m sure America will be strong for another 250

This country is built on a promise: that if you give a man a shot and his liberty under God, there’s no telling what he might accomplish 

Great to be with the @Teamsters at their 31st International Convention
